d:
Pashchim bangal men satta sanbhalne ke chhah mahine bad hi bijepi aantrik gutbaji, marpit aur avaidh vasuli ke aaropon se ghir gaee hai. parti ke bhitar 'asli bijepi' ko lekar vivad aur purv trinmul netaon ki entri ne mushkilen barha di hain. kya bijepi bhi bangal ki usi rajnitik sanskriti ka hissa banti ja rahi hai, jiska usne virodh kiya tha?
Thank you for watching our video!
